/-- A storage key that cannot leave its directory. -/
def SafeKey (k : List Nat) : Prop :=
  k ≠ [] ∧ k.all (· < 128) ∧ 0 ∉ k ∧ 92 ∉ k ∧ k.head? ≠ some 47 ∧
    ∀ seg ∈ k.splitOn 47, seg ≠ lit "." ∧ seg ≠ lit ".."
